name: Depolymerisation of PET (glycolysis, enzymatic)
applications: recycling coloured, multilayer or textile PET into new virgin-quality PET
principle: PET waste is broken back into its monomers or short fragments so that it can be purified and repolymerised into virgin-quality PET. Chemical routes such as glycolysis use glycol and heat; enzymatic routes use an engineered enzyme in water at moderate temperature. Carbios describes its C-ZYME process as solvent-free.

process_steps.name: Repolymerisation to PET
equipment: PET polymerisation line (at the host site)

performance.basis: Carbios, on Indorama Ventures' site; EUR 230 million

reference_plants.status: ground-breaking April 2024; 6-9 month delay from funding uncertainty; construction to resume late 2025; full operation anticipated 2027 (as of December 2025)

advantages: Gives virgin-quality PET from low-quality waste
Can accept coloured and textile PET
limitations: First commercial plant not yet running
Cost competitiveness against virgin PET not shown
